set.approach: From the Lower Jungle parking, follow the road to a left turn into a meadow and take the two-track to parking at the top of the valley. Head southeast on the old logging track alongside a fence (stay on its left) through a short belt of dense deadfall, and a little beyond it take the first break on the left (small cairn). The break leads to a primitive trail on the right that reaches the cliff edge; from there follow a cairned trail southeast along the rim to the crag. The north entrance is marked by two cairns, and the south-east entrance lies further on. 73 is out on the far side of the little mesa, down the talus and past several other routes, with a smooth face immediately to its right.

review.notes: Area page: approach to the crag; route page: where the route starts. No descent stated for this route.

set.approach: The Slums is the highest formation at the Overlook, lying west of The Starting Block and shady most of the day. Work down the hill beneath Howard Hughes toward the foot of the formation. For this route, go down the slope beyond Blue Suede Shoes for a short way, turn left and scramble up a little; it sits before you get down to Smiling at the Majorettes, the first climb on the left at the base.
set.descent_text: Six bolts lead to two rap bolts at the top; rappel from them.

review.notes: Route page: position relative to Blue Suede Shoes and Smiling at the Majorettes, six bolts to rap bolts; area page: walk down from Howard Hughes.
